summary: American Tower filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, announcing the pricing of a registered public offering of senior unsecured notes: $500M due 2031 at 5.300%, $500M due 2033 at 5.560%, and $600M due 2036 at 5.750%, issued at 99.718%, 99.776%, and 99.497% of face value respectively. The notes are registered debt securities listed on the NYSE. No board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are stated. This is an ordinary debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch for use of proceeds and leverage commentary.
